text: Booked the ferry, booked the hotel, and have just noticed the race is the following weekend.
Compared the two club 10Ks over five years. Ours is 40 seconds slower on median and 90 seconds slower on the winning time. Same runners, mostly — it's the course, not the field.
Anyone who says they enjoy hill reps is either lying or has never done them properly.
Entries are down 30% and the committee wants to know why. It's the price. It has been the price for three years.
Never felt better at 10 miles and never felt worse at 13. Marathon in three weeks and I have no idea what to think.
The couch to 5K completion rate here is about 20%, which is roughly what it is nationally, so the programme isn't the problem — the follow-on is. We have nothing for week 10.
Running in the dark is the best part of winter and I will not be taking questions.
Ran my fastest ever parkrun on four hours' sleep after a night shift. Everything I think I know is wrong.
Half the club's PBs were set on the same downhill course and we all know it and nobody says it.
Got my club vest today. Wore it to the shop. No regrets.
